title: Mitchell TTX · Counterair sweeps
subtitle: Figures 4–5 · three CCA axes, fighter follow-on, between-pulse pressure
description: 2024 Mitchell Institute tabletop-exercise concept: expendable CCA probe defenses on three axes ahead of F-22/F-35; recoverable CCA and stand-off F-15EX sustain pressure between maritime strike pulses.
assumptions: Published mission concepts and qualitative force-mix findings are taken from Mitchell Institute 2025 report (2024 TTX); these are hypothetical tabletop exercise plans, not observed combat operations.
Actor trajectories, coordinates, formation separations, icons, scene timing and visual counts are editorial illustrations. The report does not publish precise flight tracks or combat outcomes.
Scenario timeline is presentation seconds, not the exercise's operational day or campaign duration.
Notional CCA-1 through CCA-12 are study constructs; do not equate them with actual YFQ-designated prototypes.

phases.title: Configure three study axes
phases.narrative: The published sweep concept employs three axes of expendable CCA, with weapon-carrying and EW variants shown at a 3:1 ratio.

phases.title: Three-axis expendable CCA sweep
phases.narrative: Three CCA approach axes probe PLA defensive reactions ahead of a notional maritime strike pulse (Figure 4).

phases.title: Expose and disrupt defensive responses
phases.narrative: The report describes inducing defensive reactions and expenditure; the animation does not reproduce actual sensor detections or engagement outcomes.

phases.title: F-22 / F-35 follow-on
phases.narrative: A fifth-generation fighter group follows one of the CCA axes in the TTX concept, supported by CCA and E-7A information (Figure 4).

phases.title: Support maritime strike pulse
phases.narrative: The counterair sweep supports the notional maritime strike pulse; Figure 3 lists eight stand-off bombers, eight penetrating bombers, sixteen F-35A and sixteen F-15EX per depicted force group.

phases.title: CCA-1 and F-15EX pressure
phases.narrative: Figure 5 describes recoverable CCA-1 screening stand-off F-15EX; ISR CCA provide information for long-range counterair effects.

phases.title: Illustrative reset
phases.narrative: The study recommends varying geometries between pulses; no actual reset route or timing is published.
